title: Vocabulary Matching and Conditional Forms Practice in Unit 4
summary: A vocabulary exercise matching twelve words (such as personal trainer, profit, fitness app) with their definitions, followed by a gap-fill task completing sentences with the correct conditional forms of verbs in brackets.

title: Word Formation, Conditional Gap-Fill, and Error Correction Exercises
summary: Three grammar exercises: completing words with correct suffixes, filling gaps with appropriate words in conditional and modal contexts, and finding and rewriting mistakes in sentences.

title: Compound Nouns Matching and Gap-Fill Exercise
summary: Activities where students make compound nouns by pairing words from two columns, match them with pictures, and then use them to complete eight travel-related sentences.

title: Compound Nouns Usage Guide and Conversational Responses Matching
summary: A grammar box explaining the three forms of compound nouns (two words, hyphenated, one word) with examples, followed by an activity matching questions with appropriate responses for pair practice.

title: Ever and Never with Present Perfect Simple: Quiz, Listening, and Writing
summary: A quiz on holiday-related topics, a listening exercise matching speakers with holiday themes, grammar explanation of ever and never with present perfect simple, and a writing task using never about personal experiences.
section: Lesson 2: Have you ever stayed in a really unusual hotel?

title: Just, Already, and Yet with Present Perfect Simple Exercises
summary: A dialogue gap-fill using just, already, and yet, followed by a grammar box explaining their usage with present perfect simple, and a task completing responses with the correct word and verb.

title: How Long with Present Perfect Simple: For vs Since Grammar Exercises
summary: A collocation-finding activity referencing the Student's Book text, a grammar box explaining how long with present perfect simple using for or since, and a twelve-item exercise choosing between for and since.
section: Lesson 3: I've been coming here since 2009

title: Present Perfect Continuous Grammar and Question Formation Practice
summary: A pair-work activity asking How long questions, a grammar box on present perfect continuous for ongoing and recently finished activities, and an exercise writing questions and answers using since or for for various situations.
